result.summary: The intersection lacks essential pedestrian safety features such as marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals, despite the presence of a bus stop. The roadway surface is significantly degraded, and the environment is primarily designed for vehicular throughput rather than safe pedestrian navigation.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and mid-ground intersection area

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection has vehicle traffic lights but no visible pedestrian signal heads to indicate when it is safe to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light pole on the right corner

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The road surface is heavily worn and cracked, which can create tripping hazards and reduce vehicle stopping effectiveness.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire roadway surface

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked crosswalk, but the environment is degraded by poor pavement quality and faded markings. The lack of modern safety features like curb extensions or dedicated pedestrian signals increases risk at this crossing.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Quality
hazards.description: The roadway surface is heavily patched and uneven with multiple manhole covers, creating trip hazards and potential vehicle instability near the crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center left, crossing the main roadway

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and utility poles near the intersection corners may block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection and along the sidewalk

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with high-visibility thermoplastic continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and prevent vehicles from parking too close to the intersection, improving sightlines.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and level the roadway surface to eliminate trip hazards and provide a smooth path for all users.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and curb ramps, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals. The existing crosswalk markings are significantly faded, reducing their effectiveness in alerting drivers to the crossing zone.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk lines are heavily worn and difficult to see, which may lead to drivers failing to yield to pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, crossing the main roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, requiring pedestrians to interpret vehicle signals.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection corners.

hazards.name: Degraded Road Surface
hazards.description: Visible cracking and wear in the asphalt within the crossing area could present minor tripping hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway surface in the foreground.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse lines with continental or ladder-style markings to increase visibility to motorists.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks and curb ramps, but suffers from significant maintenance and design gaps. Faded crosswalk markings and the absence of dedicated pedestrian signals at a signalized crossing increase risk for people walking.
